appointments_provider_interval_required.name: appointments_provider_interval_required
appointments_provider_interval_required.value: "appointments"."provider_id" IS NULL OR "appointments"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL

clinical_request_keys_context.name: clinical_request_keys_context
clinical_request_keys_context.value: ("clinical_request_keys"."location_id" IS NULL AND "clinical_request_keys"."actor_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("clinical_request_keys"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "clinical_request_keys"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("clinical_request_keys"."actor_user_id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)

clinical_request_keys_key_v4.name: clinical_request_keys_key_v4
clinical_request_keys_key_v4.value: substring("clinical_request_keys"."request_key"::text from 15 for 1) = '4' AND substring("clinical_request_keys"."request_key"::text from 20 for 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b')

insurance_cases_evidence_state_check.name: insurance_cases_evidence_state_check
insurance_cases_evidence_state_check.value: ("insurance_cases"."current_evidence_id" IS NULL AND "insurance_cases"."state"='unverified') OR ("insurance_cases"."current_evidence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "insurance_cases"."state"<>'unverified')

insurance_evidence_reason_check.name: insurance_evidence_reason_check
insurance_evidence_reason_check.value: ("insurance_evidence"."reason_code"='correction' AND "insurance_evidence"."supersedes_evidence_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("insurance_evidence"."reason_code"='manual_verification' AND "insurance_evidence"."supersedes_evidence_id" IS NULL)

insurance_evidence_active_benefits_check.name: insurance_evidence_active_benefits_check
insurance_evidence_active_benefits_check.value: "insurance_evidence"."outcome"='active' OR ("insurance_evidence"."copay_cents" IS NULL AND "insurance_evidence"."deductible_remaining_cents" IS NULL AND "insurance_evidence"."coinsurance_percent" IS NULL)

marketing_interview_requests_key_v4.name: marketing_interview_requests_key_v4
marketing_interview_requests_key_v4.value: substring("marketing_interview_requests"."submission_key"::text from 15 for 1) = '4' AND substring("marketing_interview_requests"."submission_key"::text from 20 for 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b')

patient_portal_grants_verified_email_che.name: patient_portal_grants_verified_email_check
patient_portal_grants_verified_email_che.value: verified_email IS NULL OR (length(verified_email)<=254 AND verified_email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$')

patient_portal_grants_check1.name: patient_portal_grants_check1
patient_portal_grants_check1.value: NOT paperwork_email_enabled OR verified_email IS NOT NULL

communication_endpoints_check.name: communication_endpoints_check
communication_endpoints_check.value: (channel='email' AND length(address)<=254 AND address ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$') OR (channel='sms' AND address ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$')

delivery_intents_check.name: delivery_intents_check
delivery_intents_check.value: (purpose IN ('paperwork_ready','paperwork_resend'))=(paperwork_notification_id IS NOT NULL AND library_item_id IS NOT NULL AND document_version_id IS NOT NULL AND recipient_grant_id IS NOT NULL)

patient_reminder_policies_check.name: patient_reminder_policies_check
patient_reminder_policies_check.value: cardinality(slots_hours) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND slots_hours <@ ARRAY[48,24]

staff_fanout.name: staff_fanout
staff_fanout.withCheck: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM practice_member_access m JOIN location_assignments a ON a.practice_id=m.practice_id AND a.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.practice_id=staff_notifications.practice_id AND m.user_id=staff_notifications.recipient_user_id AND m.status='active' AND a.location_id=staff_notifications.location_id AND a.active)

audit_reader_event_scope.name: audit_reader_event_scope
audit_reader_event_scope.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM audit.events e
  WHERE ((e.id = changes.event_id) AND (e.practice_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.practice_id'::text)))))

changes_check.name: changes_check
changes_check.value: ((capture_mode = 'value'::text) OR ((before_value IS NULL) AND (after_value IS NULL)))

document_requests_form_policy_check.name: document_requests_form_policy_check
document_requests_form_policy_check.value: ((purpose='form_completion' AND form_completion_policy IS NOT NULL AND form_completion_policy IN ('form_only','form_then_sign')) OR (purpose<>'form_completion' AND form_completion_policy IS NULL))

patient_form_template_read.name: patient_form_template_read
patient_form_template_read.using: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM template_versions v JOIN prepared_documents p ON p.template_version_id=v.id AND p.practice_id=v.practice_id WHERE v.template_id=document_templates.id AND v.practice_id=document_templates.practice_id AND careiq_patient_form_scope(p.id))

audit_reader_event_scope.name: audit_reader_event_scope
audit_reader_event_scope.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM audit.events e
  WHERE ((e.id = event_resources.event_id) AND (e.practice_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.practice_id'::text)))))

events_check.name: events_check
events_check.value: (((scope_kind = 'platform'::text) AND (practice_id IS NULL) AND (location_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'practice'::text) AND (practice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (location_id IS NULL)) OR ((scope_kind = 'location'::text) AND (practice_id IS NOT NULL) AND (location_id IS NOT NULL)))

patient_scan_run_scope.name: patient_scan_run_scope
patient_scan_run_scope.using:
careiq_patient_scope('file_objects'::text, ( SELECT to_jsonb(f.*) AS to_jsonb
   FROM file_objects f
  WHERE ((f.id = file_scan_runs.file_object_id) AND (f.patient_id = file_scan_runs.patient_id) AND (f.practice_id = file_scan_runs.practice_id) AND (f.location_id = file_scan_runs.location_id))))
patient_scan_run_scope.withCheck:
careiq_patient_scope('file_objects'::text, ( SELECT to_jsonb(f.*) AS to_jsonb
   FROM file_objects f
  WHERE ((f.id = file_scan_runs.file_object_id) AND (f.patient_id = file_scan_runs.patient_id) AND (f.practice_id = file_scan_runs.practice_id) AND (f.location_id = file_scan_runs.location_id))))

patient_form_candidate_insert.name: patient_form_candidate_insert
patient_form_candidate_insert.withCheck: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM form_submissions s WHERE s.id=form_change_candidates.submission_id AND s.patient_id=form_change_candidates.patient_id AND s.practice_id=form_change_candidates.practice_id AND s.location_id=form_change_candidates.location_id AND careiq_patient_form_scope(s.prepared_document_id))

form_change_decisions_decision_check.name: form_change_decisions_decision_check
form_change_decisions_decision_check.value: decision IN('accepted','rejected') AND length(reason_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND (destination_revision IS NULL OR destination_revision>0)

form_submissions_source_check.name: form_submissions_source_check
form_submissions_source_check.value: schema_version IN(1,2) AND jsonb_typeof(answers)='object' AND octet_length(answers::text)<=131072 AND jsonb_typeof(active_field_keys)='array' AND schema_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND answers_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND locale IN('en','es')

patient_job_run_scope.name: patient_job_run_scope
patient_job_run_scope.using:
careiq_patient_scope('workflow_operations'::text, ( SELECT to_jsonb(o.*) AS to_jsonb
   FROM workflow_operations o
  WHERE ((o.id = job_runs.operation_id) AND (o.practice_id = job_runs.practice_id) AND (o.location_id = job_runs.location_id))))
patient_job_run_scope.withCheck:
careiq_patient_scope('workflow_operations'::text, ( SELECT to_jsonb(o.*) AS to_jsonb
   FROM workflow_operations o
  WHERE ((o.id = job_runs.operation_id) AND (o.practice_id = job_runs.practice_id) AND (o.location_id = job_runs.location_id))))

audit_reader_event_scope.name: audit_reader_event_scope
audit_reader_event_scope.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM audit.events e
  WHERE ((e.id = retention_assignments.event_id) AND (e.practice_id = careiq_context_uuid('app.practice_id'::text)))))

retention_assignments_check.name: retention_assignments_check
retention_assignments_check.value: ((event_id IS NOT NULL) OR (batch_id IS NOT NULL))

patient_form_binding_read.name: patient_form_binding_read
patient_form_binding_read.using: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prepared_documents p WHERE p.template_version_id=template_field_bindings.template_version_id AND p.practice_id=template_field_bindings.practice_id AND careiq_patient_form_scope(p.id))

patient_form_version_read.name: patient_form_version_read
patient_form_version_read.using: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prepared_documents p WHERE p.template_version_id=template_versions.id AND p.practice_id=template_versions.practice_id AND careiq_patient_form_scope(p.id))

visit_requirements_check.name: visit_requirements_check
visit_requirements_check.value: ((lifecycle_state <> 'waived'::text) OR ((waiver_reason_code IS NOT NULL) AND (waived_by_actor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (waived_at IS NOT NULL)))

patient_request_retry_scope.name: patient_request_retry_scope
patient_request_retry_scope.using: (careiq_patient_scope('document_requests'::text, jsonb_build_object('id', target_id, 'practice_id', practice_id, 'location_id', location_id)) AND (actor_user_id = (careiq_resolve_patient_access(NULLIF(current_setting('app.patient_token_hash'::text, true), ''::text), true) ->> 'session_id'::text)))
patient_request_retry_scope.withCheck: (careiq_patient_scope('document_requests'::text, jsonb_build_object('id', target_id, 'practice_id', practice_id, 'location_id', location_id)) AND (actor_user_id = (careiq_resolve_patient_access(NULLIF(current_setting('app.patient_token_hash'::text, true), ''::text), true) ->> 'session_id'::text)))
